age.evidence: weighing approximately 275 -300 g at the start of the experiments

sex.evidence: A total of 57 male Wistar rats (Harlan Ibérica, Barcelona, Spain)

dosing.doses_raw: DOI (0.1, 0.3 and 0.5 mg/kg) in group 3; DOI (0.5 mg/kg) in combined treatments
dosing.evidence: DOI hydrochloride ... and ketanserin tartrate ... were dissolved in 0.9 % saline ... and injected subcutaneously. ... approximately 30 min before behavioural testing ... fully randomised Latin-square design and separated by a minimum of 72 h between drug test sessions

group_housing.evidence: The animals were housed three rats per cage (50×15×25 cm)

day_night_flipped.evidence: with a 12:12-h light -dark cycle (light off at 08:00 h) ... All testing was performed between 09:00 and 14:00 h.

assays.assay_description: Food-restricted rats in MED Associates operant SIP chambers (32×25×34 cm) under a fixed-time 60-s food pellet schedule in 60-min sessions with a 100-ml water bottle available. After 20 acquisition sessions rats were split into high (HD) and low (LD) drinkers. Measures: water intake, total licks, magazine entries. Drug tests (Latin square, Tue/Fri) included citalopram, atomoxetine, DOI (0.1-0.5 mg/kg s.c.), 5-HT2A/2C antagonists alone, and DOI 0.5 mg/kg combined with ketanserin, M100907 or SB242084 — collapsed into one assay.

application_type.evidence: DOI hydrochloride ... and ketanserin tartrate ... were dissolved in 0.9 % saline ... and injected subcutaneously. (Co-administered M100907 and SB242084 were given ip.)

setup_habituation.evidence: After 1 day of adaptation, the animals were exposed to a fixed time 60-s (FT-60s) schedule of food pellet presentation in 60-min sessions.

setup_restrain.evidence: Three cohorts of rats were tested in 13 operant SIP chambers (32×25×34 cm); no restraint described in free-movement operant chamber.

food_restriction.evidence: the rats were gradually reduced to 85 % of their free-feeding body weight through controlled feeding, and their body weights were maintained at this level of deprivation throughout the experiment.

water_restriction.evidence: Water bottles containing 100 ml of fresh water were provided during each session.

time_to_assay.evidence: the time to injection, approximately 30 min before behavioural testing

sample_size.evidence: A total of 57 male Wistar rats ... the number of animals in each group of LD and HD rats was n =9 -10 (DOI-treated group 3: F 1,18 implies n=20)

outcomes.summary: DOI (0.1, 0.3, 0.5 mg/kg s.c.) dose-dependently reduced water intake and total licks in high-drinker rats without affecting low drinkers or magazine entries. The DOI (0.5 mg/kg) reduction was blocked by ketanserin (1 mg/kg) and M100907 (1 mg/kg) but not by the 5-HT2C antagonist SB242084.
outcomes.evidence: Post hoc analyses revealed that DOI produced a dosedependent reduction in water intake in the HD group at 0.1, 0.3 and 0.5 mg/kg ( p <0.001) compared with saline in the same group. In addition, DOI did not affect water intake in LD rats.

B1_num_measures.evidence: (a) total amount of water (millilitres) removed from the bottle, (b) total number of licks to the bottle and (c) total number of entries into the food magazine

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Measures reported as session totals; acquisition analysed across sessions (between-session), not within-session.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences or bout structure reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Measures are water intake, licks and magazine entries.

B5_social.evidence: Rats tested individually in operant SIP chambers; no social construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: SIP ... development of a non-thirsty-motivated adjunctive drinking behaviour under an intermittent reinforcement programme; acquired over 20 operant FT-60s sessions.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The scheduling and recording of the experimental events were controlled using a computer and commercial software Med PC

B8_multivariate.evidence: two-way repeated measure ANOVA ... three-way repeated measure ANOVA (univariate tests only)

E1_environment_type.evidence: 13 operant SIP chambers (32×25×34 cm) (MED Associates, St. Albans, VT, USA)

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter described in the operant chamber.

E7_social_context.evidence: Rats tested individually in operant SIP chambers (13 chambers for cohorts).

E8_food_water.evidence: fixed time 60-s (FT-60s) schedule of food pellet presentation in 60-min sessions. Water bottles containing 100 ml of fresh water were provided during each session.

D1_continuity.evidence: After 20 daily sessions ... separated by a minimum of 72 h between drug test sessions

D3_recording_days.evidence: The mean water intake ... across 20 sessions of SIP (Fig. 2), plus Latin-square drug test sessions on Tuesdays and Fridays

D4_baseline.evidence: Over two successive days, a water ingestion test was given (baseline) ... 20 drug-free acquisition sessions reported in Fig. 2 before drug testing.

D5_followup.evidence: Behavioural data reported only from drug test sessions ~30 min post-injection; post-drug sessions on Wednesdays 'the results were not analysed'.

judge_notes: Single assay (SIP) — all drug experiments (dose-response, antagonist alone, DOI+antagonist combinations) collapsed per rubric; all candidates agreed on one assay.
B1 set to score 1 (2-3 measures: water intake, licks, magazine entries); gemma's score 2 was inconsistent with its own '2-3' value and deepseek's 4-6 double-counted acquisition data.
B6 = Yes following modal candidates (operant FT schedule with acquisition over 20 sessions).
D3 = 15+ because 20 acquisition sessions plus drug-test sessions had data reported (Fig. 2); qwen's evidence matches the paper.
food_restriction = 'before' (85% body-weight restriction prior to/throughout training, per rubric example); water_restriction = 'no' since water bottle available during session (modal).
application_type = s.c. as DOI was injected subcutaneously; antagonists M100907/SB242084 given i.p. noted in evidence.
day_night_flipped = yes: lights off at 08:00, testing 09:00-14:00 (dark phase).
DOI set to null: candidates gave conflicting DOIs and the markdown lacks one.
n_total kept at 57 (whole SIP cohort); DOI-treated group 3 comprised ~20 rats.
